suspicious_entropy.name: .text
suspicious_entropy.justification: Section '.text' has entropy 6.44 (6.0-7.5). This is moderately high and may indicate obfuscated or compressed data. While this could be legitimate (e.g., resource data), in the context of malware it often suggests packing or string obfuscation.

entropy_analysis.justification: Overall file entropy is 5.91, which is within the normal range for executables (typically 5.5-6.5). No significant entropy anomalies detected.
